messages:
sara: quick thread: small follow-up to pinning schema RFC. proposing a 'variant umbrella' mode — treat tiny, non-semantic variant diffs as one routing/telemetry surface for a short TTL to cut churn on perf/quant canaries.

mike: ok. main worry is silent semantic drift. how do we define "non-semantic"? one eval number feels fragile.

yun: agree. require onboarding to emit an evidence bundle: eval_id + delta_metrics (narrative + numeric). platform runs a smoke verification. only grant umbrella when score > threshold. still expose per-variant traces in telemetry.

kevin: schema sketch: umbrella_id:string, umbrella_ttl_days:int, umbrella_mode:enum("strict","permissive"), evidence_id:string, umbrella_score:float, umbrella_pools:list. router must deterministically map to avoid flapping.

lucas: tenant pin precedence is mandatory. tenant_settings.allow_umbrella=false opt-out for regulated customers. if tenant pinned, always route to pinned variant.

ops-bot: infra-bot: Canary deploy started for variant v4-int8 on canary/2026-03-20 :rocket:

mike: deprecation lifecycle: phases = umbrella_soft (grouping + telemetry), notice (notify tenants + suggested_migrate), umbrella_retire (hard). add deprecation_phase + deprecation_eta fields.

sara: audit note: umbrella is operational only; audit logs must record exact variant_hash and resolved umbrella_id per inference so audits see concrete hashes.

kevin: implementation: compute umbrella_id deterministically: sha256(owner_id + sorted variant hashes). store canonical member list + formed_ts. backfill must use same algorithm.

yun: autoscaler note: umbrella mixing different hardware pools can break capacity planning. require umbrella_pools and a pool_fallback_policy enum("prefer","mirror","reject").

lucas: UX: show "Suggested migration" banner with expected latency/cost deltas and one-click opt-in. provide migration metrics post-migrate.

mike: telemetry to collect: migration_success_rate, post-umbrella_regressions, latency_p95_delta, cost_delta_per_token, false_positive_count, and time_to_revoke when group revoked.

sara: revocation flow: platform emits revoke event + revocation_reason + revocation_ts; optionally split umbrella automatically if regression detected. include playbook thresholds in RFC.

sara: next steps: i'll open RFC + data-model PR with fields above and example logs and UI copy. will include retention requirements for 90/365 day audit exports. linking draft when up.
